title: nixos/paperless: mirror upstream admin user creation more closely
reason: Applicable: real paperless module + wired test (nixos/tests/all-tests.nix at head 7afa349ea contains 'paperless = handleTest ./paperless.nix {};'). Real diff genuinely restructures a Nix-level predicate into a runtime one: BEFORE, the whole superuser-bootstrap bash block was wrapped in `lib.optionalString (cfg.passwordFile != null) ''...''` -- a Nix-BUILD-TIME predicate that OMITS the block entirely from the generated preStart script when passwordFile is unset. AFTER, the block is unconditionally emitted, with an internal bash-level `if ${lib.boolToString (cfg.passwordFile != null)} || [[ -n $PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD ]]; then ... fi` runtime check instead -- passwordFile's own declared mkOption (line 176) is unchanged, but where/how its truthiness gates behavior moved from Nix-evaluation-time to systemd-runtime, and gained a second OR'd condition (a runtime env var) that Nix-level analysis cannot see at all.
targets_toml: single target paperless, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,paperless], watch=[passwordFile].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: FLAGGING PROMINENTLY: audit-diff's own rendered summary.md classifies this as 'Unchanged: 1' (the verdict STRING 'TestConfigUnresolved' is identical both sides), but the raw predicate_attempts arrays underneath are NOT identical: base shows 2 predicate sites referencing `passwordFile != null` (line 417 -- an unrelated, unchanged lib.optionalString elsewhere in the file -- and line 454, the one this PR actually restructured), while head shows only 1 (line 417 only; the line-454 site is genuinely gone from head, replaced by the runtime bash conditional described above). So the underlying EVIDENCE changed (a predicate site was structurally removed from the Nix-evaluable surface) even though the top-level verdict CLASS did not, and audit-diff's own 'Unchanged' classification does not surface this to a maintainer reading only the rendered summary. Both base and head are TestConfigUnresolved rather than a concrete witness because the real nixos/tests/paperless.nix test does not set passwordFile to a literal Nix-visible value (likely a generated secrets file or similar, opaque to the walker) -- not making a correctness judgment on whether 'Unchanged' is the RIGHT classification here, just flagging that the raw evidence underneath a verdict class that looks stable is not actually stable, which seems like exactly the kind of case a maintainer-facing summary could mislead on.
